The real owner takes no parameter (the template's `actor` argument is never referenced anywhere in this owner's disassembly -- r0 is overwritten before any use), calls none of the template's shop/UiWindow_CreateFar/Ability_GetAvailability functions, and instead drives a base-object pointer read from the SAME Data_03001ea0 workspace used by the already-drafted siblings 0801db70.c (measured-draft), games/gs1/src/unidentified/main/field/field_owner_54.c (exact), and games/gs1/src/unidentified/main/runtime/runtime_owner_123.c (exact). games/gs1/src/shop/select_party_member.c was also checked directly and shares no call targets, constants, or field offsets with this owner either -- neither shop sibling is the real family for this address.

domain: Cycles a 0-4 'page' index (var stored at workspace+0x574, updated via a mod-5 Modulo(page+delta,5) idiom identical to the field_owner_54.c/0801db70.c siblings) and, on every redraw, recomputes a per-page byte at workspace+0x594[page] from workspace+0x594[page]+workspace+0x599[page] (mod 5), then redraws three fixed icon rows of length 3/2/2 at workspace+0x5EC/0x5F8/0x604 (each entry a pointer to a RenderOutput-shaped widget: byte 0xF set to the 0xFB sentinel, refreshed via Func_080a1038, then loaded via RenderResource_LoadFrame with an icon id pulled from one of three ROM byte arrays Data_080367c9/cc/ce and a selected/highlight flag computed against the fixed workspace bytes 0x596/0x597/0x598), draws two Func_080b0030 number/quantity readouts keyed off workspace bytes 0x594/0x595 (via FixedPoint_Ratio and a per-page ROM table at the constant read from workspace+0x599/0x59A), draws three portrait/character cells (Func_080164d4 + UiText_DrawCharacter) whose resource id is workspace[0x596/0x597/0x598] plus the fixed constants 0xC0A/0xC10/0xC13, combines the two byte selections via Func_0801ccc0, and draws a final cursor-position readout keyed off the current page. The polling tail advances the page's animation counter at workspace+0x57E (wrapping past a 0x50000/65536 threshold and re-deriving the two byte selections from Data_080367d0/d6 tables) on input bit 4, confirms (bit0/bit3 -> result 0, or bit1 -> result -1) or steps the current page's byte up/down/left/right on ADDR_03001B04, then on exit either snapshots the five workspace selection bytes (0x594-0x598) into five fixed globals (0x02000445/446/44C/44A/046A and 0x03001D08) or, on cancel, feeds the previously-snapshotted pair back through Func_0801ccc0. This reads as a per-party-slot equipment/ability loadout picker (three always-visible option rows plus a per-page remembered selection), not the assigned shop template's item-list menu.
notes: Recovered entirely from games/gs1/asm/0801d4cc.s (the owner's own retained disassembly, hand-walked instruction by instruction to resolve every pc-relative literal-pool word and branch target) plus the family-transplant workspace's m2c-assisted control-flow recovery (out/family-transplants/main-0801d4cc/m2c/0801d4cc.c) as a structural cross-check -- every field offset, constant, and call target the m2c draft proposed was independently re-derived from the raw .s before being trusted (m2c mis-rendered one call's second argument as dropped in one spot, caught by re-reading the raw asm). Already-adopted siblings sharing the same Data_03001ea0 workspace (field_owner_54.c, runtime_owner_123.c, 0801db70.c) supplied the field_offset conventions (0x574 = page/selection, 0x594.. = a per-page byte array, FIELD/M2C_FIELD macro style) and the already-resolved real names for seven callees via games/gs1/include/types.h's existing #define aliases (Modulo, FixedPoint_Ratio, RenderResource_CreatePair, RenderResource_LoadFrame, UiText_DrawCharacter, UiText_DrawResource, UiWork_Finalize, RenderOutput_ClearList, WaitFrames, Audio_PlayCue, UiWindow_Create).

Initial naive draft (m2c output, types fixed up, real callee names substituted) measured differing_halfwords=542 with a single dominant structural defect: the reference keeps the workspace base pointer resident in r7 and the Func_0801d108() result resident in r8 for the entire function, while the candidate's allocator instead put base in r8 and the other value in sl (a full one-slot register-set shift). Root cause found and fixed: the three icon-row loops originally cached each row's `*(void**)(base+slot)` widget pointer into a local `elem` variable used both before and after the intervening Func_080a1038(elem) call; the reference's compiler instead re-reads `*(void**)(base+slot)` fresh after that call rather than keeping it resident across it. Rewriting the loops to re-dereference `*(void**)(base+slot)` at each use point (no cached local) freed exactly the one register of pressure needed for base to land back in r7, dropping the metric to 533 and restoring the correct base/icon/page/redraw register set for the whole function body.

Three further verified, net-positive respellings on top of that fix: (1) explicitly caching `&workspace[0x598]` into a `p598` pointer local, read via `*p598`, for both the third icon-loop's comparison and the later post-loop 0xC13 portrait-id computation -- matches the reference's own opportunistic reuse of a spare register (sl) across that specific loop/post-loop pair (520, from 533); (2) hoisting `s32 rowX = icon->x * 8;` as its own statement immediately before each of the two Func_080b0030 quantity-readout calls, instead of writing `icon->x*8 + 0x8C + FixedPoint_Ratio(...)` as one expression -- the reference evaluates icon->x*8 before the FixedPoint_Ratio call in both call sites and the inline expression form was letting the compiler defer that multiply until after the call (508, from 520); (3) reading the workspace+0x598 byte once into a `u8 v` local and storing it to both of its two final fixed-address destinations from that local, matching the reference's single ldrb + two strb, instead of two independent FIELD reads (folded into the 542->533 step above, net positive on its own).

This owner's overall control flow, every branch target, every literal-pool constant, and every call target were independently confirmed to match the reference at matched_prefix=13 (the entire prologue and setup sequence, including the corrected base/icon/page/redraw register assignment, is now byte-identical) before the remaining residual was accepted as a stopping point for this pass.
